description: This file defines the AppTheme class which provides a static method to generate a custom light theme for a Flutter application, including styling for colors, app bar, cards, text, input fields, chips, and buttons.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class that provides theming configurations for the Flutter app.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with a custom light theme, including color scheme, text styles, input decorations, and component themes.
